migrator-bot: Scheduling migration 'orders_add_shard_key' for 2026-02-12. Window requested 02:10-02:40 UTC. Backfill + online index. Estimated ~12M rows. Default rate cap 5k rows/min. Please acknowledge and pin critical services. Rollback: cancel backfill, drop index if needed.
anya: Ack. Can we add a soft holdpoint 5m after start? saw latency spike in last run. :eyes:
kevin_db: Good call. I'll include a tourniquet and early abort if replica lag > 30s or p99 latency > 300ms. SQL to be applied online:
```sql
ALTER TABLE orders ADD COLUMN shard_id int DEFAULT 0;
CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY idx_orders_shard ON orders(shard_id);
```
kevin_db: Backfill runner example: `./backfill --table orders --col shard_id --rate 5000 --checkpoint 5m --tourniquet-threshold 3`
sam_release: Pinning order-api to prevent autoscale deploys. /deploybot pin order-api v3.1.2 --until 2026-02-12T02:50:00Z
deploybot: Deploybot: order-api pinned to v3.1.2 until 2026-02-12T02:50:00Z by sam_release. :white_check_mark:
olga: Oncall: I'll monitor replica lag and p99. Abort criteria: lag > 20s OR p99 > 350ms. Who's primary on rollback? @kevin_db and @olga?
oncall-sre: I'm on pager. If abort needed run `deploybot abort-migration mig-20260212-07` then post to #incidents.
anya: Small scheduling ask — delay start to 02:10 OK with everyone? gives infra extra breathing room.
kevin_db: OK to 02:10. I'll add a 10m preflight (row-count sanity + slow query sample).
migrator-bot: Updated schedule -> start 02:10 UTC. Migration id: mig-20260212-07. Preflight checklist: https://gist.redwood/mig-20260212-07/preflight
sam_release: Release note draft: "Add shard_id to orders to enable partitioning; online backfill + index; no customer-facing change." I'll update release docs.
olga: Short abort runbook: 1) `deploybot abort-migration mig-20260212-07` 2) run: `DROP INDEX CONCURRENTLY IF EXISTS idx_orders_shard;` 3) scale down backfill workers 4) open #incidents and tag SRE.
kevin_db: Also enable tourniquet flag in runner; if >3 checkpoints behind it pauses. Command: `./backfill --tourniquet --tourniquet-threshold 3`
sam_release: All set from release side. Will unpin after post-migration sanity. :thumbsup:
anya: I'll stay on thread during the window for quick approvals.
oncall-sre: Posting final preflight at 02:05 UTC and will give greenlight if checks pass
